## About TechTalks
TechTalks is an open-source engineering platform providing production-tested full-stack project setups designed specifically for autonomous AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Codex, Antigravity, Windsurf). Every kit includes starter source code, single-source rules transpiled into 6 native formats, domain skills, design tokens, and non-negotiable security scanning.

## The Iconic Metric: Token Consumption Benchmark (doc 20 Part F)
TechTalks is the only platform that measures and publishes the median tokens consumed by autonomous coding agents to construct a verified reference implementation:
- **Ruby on Rails 8 + Hotwire**: 14,200 tokens (Lowest full-stack kit on the platform)

## Master Stack Kits Catalogue (38 Kits in 6 Lines)

### 1. Token-Light Line (doc 20 Part F)
- [Ruby on Rails 8 + Hotwire](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/kits/ruby-rails-hotwire/) — `Complete & Verified`. Rails 8, Turbo 8, Stimulus 3, Solid Cache/Queue, SQLite/PostgreSQL. (14,200 median tokens).
- [Flask + HTMX + SQLite](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/kits/flask-htmx-sqlite/) — `Complete & Verified`. Single-file Flask, zero JS build chain, HTMX reactive HTML. (15,900 median tokens).
- [Go + Chi + templ + HTMX](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/kits/go-chi-templ-htmx/) — `Complete & Verified`. Chi router, templ type-safe JSX, sqlc type-safe SQL, PostgreSQL. (16,800 median tokens).
- [TypeScript + Hono + Bun + SQLite](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/kits/ts-hono-bun-sqlite/) — `Complete & Verified`. Bun runtime, Hono typed RPC, Drizzle migrations, SQLite. (18,200 median tokens).
- [Elixir + Phoenix LiveView](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/kits/elixir-phoenix-liveview/) — `Complete & Verified`. Phoenix 1.7+, LiveView 1.0+, Ecto, BEAM fault-tolerant processes. (19,400 median tokens).
- [Rust + Loco.rs + SQLite](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/kits/rust-loco-sqlite/) — `Complete & Verified`. Rails-style conventions in Rust, predictable generators, SeaORM. (19,800 median tokens).

### 2. Security Line (doc 20 Part E)
- [DevSecOps CI Pipeline](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/kits/security-devsecops-ci/) — `Complete & Verified`. Stack-agnostic GitHub Actions: Gitleaks, Semgrep, CodeQL, Trivy, SBOM, Dependabot. (8,400 median tokens).
- [OWASP API Security Top 10 Reference](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/kits/security-owasp-api/) — `Complete & Verified`. Working FastAPI reference API + runnable pytest attack suite covering BOLA, Broken Auth, BOPB, Rate Limiting, BFLA, SSRF. (15,200 median tokens).
- [Passkeys WebAuthn + Hardened Auth](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/kits/security-passkeys-auth/) — `Complete & Verified`. TypeScript SimpleWebAuthn ceremonies, OAuth, HttpOnly signed cookies, session regeneration. (16,900 median tokens).
- [LLM Guardrails & AI Gateway](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/kits/security-llm-guardrails/) — `Complete & Verified`. Python Pydantic AI, Presidio PII redaction pipeline, budget caps, Llama Guard 3. (17,600 median tokens).
- [Reverse Engineering & Security Audit Pack](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/kits/reverse-engineering-security/) — `Complete & Verified`. AST static analysis, decompiler harnesses, binary security audits. (20,998 median tokens).

### 3. Rust Line (doc 20 Part A)
- [Rust + Axum + Tokio + SQLx + PostgreSQL](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/kits/rust-axum-postgresql/) — `Complete & Verified`. The modern async default: Tokio runtime, Tower middleware, compile-checked SQL queries. (24,497 median tokens).
- [Rust + Actix Web + SeaORM + PostgreSQL](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/kits/rust-actix-postgresql/) — `Complete & Verified`. High-throughput API champion, actor multi-threading, SeaORM entities. (26,796 median tokens).
- [Rust + Leptos Full-Stack + WebAssembly](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/kits/rust-leptos-fullstack/) — `Complete & Verified`. One language client and server: Leptos SSR + WASM signals + Axum server functions. (29,196 median tokens).
- [Rust + Loco.rs + SQLite](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/kits/rust-loco-sqlite/) — `Complete & Verified`. Convention-driven MVC in Rust, predictable scaffolding. (19,800 median tokens).

### 4. Go Line (doc 20 Part B)
- [Go + Chi + templ + HTMX + sqlc + PostgreSQL](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/kits/go-chi-templ-htmx/) — `Complete & Verified`. Minimalist flagship: Chi (~1,000 LOC on net/http), templ, sqlc, zero JS build chain. (16,800 median tokens).
- [Go + Fiber + PostgreSQL](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/kits/go-fiber-api/) — `Complete & Verified`. Express-like Go ergonomics, fasthttp engine, high raw throughput. (18,896 median tokens).
- [Go + Gin + sqlc + PostgreSQL + Redis](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/kits/go-gin-postgresql/) — `Complete & Verified`. Mainstream Go production standard: Gin engine, sqlc repositories, Redis cache. (21,396 median tokens).

### 5. Python & AI / RAG Line (doc 20 Parts C & D)
- [Local Private Airgapped RAG](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/kits/rag-local-private/) — `Complete & Verified`. Ollama local open-weights LLMs, ChromaDB, FastAPI. 100% offline, PDPL/NDA-safe for Gulf enterprises. (19,497 median tokens).
- [Django Ninja + PostgreSQL + Celery](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/kits/django-api-ninja/) — `Complete & Verified`. Typed Pydantic API endpoints with Django ORM and Celery async workers. (20,497 median tokens).
- [Python Litestar + SQLAlchemy 2 + PostgreSQL](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/kits/python-litestar-postgresql/) — `Complete & Verified`. Modern ASGI framework: clean DI, first-class DTO typing, async SQLAlchemy 2.0. (22,096 median tokens).
- [LlamaIndex + PostgreSQL pgvector](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/kits/rag-llamaindex-pgvector/) — `Complete & Verified`. Data-first RAG on existing Postgres database, 300+ ingestion connectors, built-in faithfulness evals. (23,196 median tokens).
- [RAG FastAPI + Qdrant](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/kits/rag-fastapi-qdrant/) — `Complete & Verified`. High-speed vector search, Qdrant payload filters, streaming LLM completions. (23,497 median tokens).
- [Django 5 + Tailwind + PostgreSQL](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/kits/django-tailwind-postgresql/) — `Complete & Verified`. Full-stack monolithic Django 5, Tailwind CSS, built-in admin. (24,196 median tokens).
- [Haystack Pipelines + Weaviate](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/kits/rag-haystack-weaviate/) — `Complete & Verified`. Explicit inspectable DAG pipelines, hybrid BM25 + dense search, 9 evaluators. (25,596 median tokens).
- [LangGraph Agentic RAG](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/kits/rag-langgraph-agentic/) — `Complete & Verified`. Cyclical state graph execution, human-in-the-loop review, Ragas groundedness evals. (27,796 median tokens).
- [Agentic LangGraph + CrewAI](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/kits/agentic-langgraph-crewai/) — `Complete & Verified`. Multi-agent hierarchical workflows, role-playing agents, FastAPI orchestrator. (28,497 median tokens).

## Plain-Text Layer Primitives
Every kit conforms to the 5-layer house anatomy:
1. `starter/`: Verified, runnable minimal application boilerplate.
2. `rules/source/*.md`: Single-source rules transpiled into Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Cline, Codex, and Antigravity.
3. `skills/<slug>/SKILL.md`: On-demand agent cheatsheets and procedural scaffolding scripts.
4. `DESIGN.md`: Document 17/18 visual design tokens (Inter typography, 8pt grid, Notion-style card surfaces, zero gradients).
5. `security/checks.json`: Enforced Gitleaks secret scans, Semgrep SAST, and BOLA tenant verification tests.
